culprit_citations.quoted_text: Cinelease, LLC | 08/07/25 | ABL Term Loan - 11.17 % (SOFR + 7.50 %, 2.50 % Floor)

rationale: The raw schedule explicitly states an all-in coupon of 11.17% and a separate contractual spread of SOFR + 7.50%. Agent A extracted 7.5%, exactly matching the source spread. The 4.9912 percentage-point comparison residual therefore reflects an invalid comparison of the spread with an all-in XBRL rate, rather than a data error in the Agent A value.
